THE RESIDENCE

Open spaces.

A bright, open-concept home in the Calusa neighborhood of Kendall. Vaulted ceilings and wood-look porcelain flooring create an airy setting, with living spaces that open toward the pool and backyard.

From the kitchen island to the sunlit patio, there’s room to gather, unwind, and make it your own.
